archiveTitle: Daily Brief | シノビNEXUS -閃乱カグラ-: SHINOBI NEXUS -Senran Kagura- launches November 29

entries.headline: シノビNEXUS -閃乱カグラ-: SHINOBI NEXUS -Senran Kagura- launches November 29
entries.summary: HONEY∞PARADE GAMES says the turn-based command RPG will launch for PC, iOS and Android on November 29, with pre-downloads opening on November 28. Its systems include character outfits and the Shinobi Spa.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly attributes the date, platforms and features to the company announcement.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Arknights: Endfield update Meeting You in the World o’Shrooms arrives November 25
entries.summary: GRYPHLINE and Mountain Contour announced the November 25 update. The livestream also previewed version 2.0, its new region and Rhodes Island landship, plus 10 characters planned across future updates.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report attributes the date and preview details to the publisher and developer.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: VALORANT: 2027 VCT Pacific Kickoff Japan Qualifier reveals its bracket
entries.summary: The open qualifier is split into six groups and begins November 22. One champion will advance through the three-stage competition to the international VCT Pacific Kickoff in Bangkok.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the bracket, format and qualification path to VALORANT Champions Tour JAPAN.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: WePlay Expo 2026 opens in Shanghai as a Japan edition targets spring 2027
entries.summary: CiGA's WePlay Expo 2026 runs in Shanghai on November 21 and 22 and marks the event's tenth anniversary. A Japan edition is planned for spring 2027.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer page supports the host, dates, anniversary and Japan-edition window.
entries.timeNote: Published three minutes before the fixed cutoff.

entries.headline: Researchers use Grand Theft Auto V to visualize sea-level rise
entries.summary: Researchers at the Alfred Wegener Institute and the University of Potsdam used Los Santos for flood visualization and compared the results with Los Angeles. Their paper appeared in Geoscience Communication on November 17.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report identifies the researchers, paper, journal and comparison.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI players report CE-108255-1 crashes on PS5
entries.summary: Some PS5 and PS5 Pro players report frequent crashes carrying error CE-108255-1, with some cases blocking story progress. No broadly verified fix was available when the report was published.
entries.verification: The opened report supports only the player reports; it does not establish the affected share or an official root cause.
entries.timeNote: The report is in-window, but the issue's start time remains unconfirmed.

entries.headline: Neuralink trial participant demonstrates Grand Theft Auto VI through a brain interface
entries.summary: A Neuralink clinical-trial participant demonstrated driving boats, flying planes and fighting in the game through the interface. Neuralink stressed that the participant is part of an extremely limited clinical trial.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the demonstration and Neuralink's statement about the trial's limited scope.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Text psychological horror game Phobophilia Syndrome launches free
entries.summary: Writer Ei Asou's roughly 90,000-word psychological-horror adventure is free on itch.io for Windows PC. The text-led game takes inspiration from SCP and advances through player choices.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report states the creator, platform, price, scale and format.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Deduction game LAST RELAY 23 launches free on unityroom and itch.io
entries.summary: Players cross-reference chat logs and city records to restore the recipients of 47 meeting messages. Developer Orange Lily says a full run takes about three to four hours.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the gameplay, free release, platforms, message count and playtime.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Mega Crit producer Casey Yano discusses the goals behind Slay the Spire 2
entries.summary: At CiGADC in Shanghai, Yano looked back on the first game's development and Early Access lessons while describing his ambition to make Slay the Spire 2 his best work.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer page supports the speaker, venue and discussion scope; no additional design claims were added.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.
